import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    feature_cols = [
        'order_count', 'item_count', 'total_revenue', 'avg_price', 'median_price',
        'std_price', 'unique_sellers', 'days_since_last_purchase', 'product_age_days',
        'avg_freight', 'sales_last_30d', 'sales_last_90d', 'sales_prev_90d',
        'trend_30_vs_prev30', 'avg_installments', 'avg_review_score',
        'review_count', 'share_score_1_2', 'avg_delivery_days',
        'avg_delivery_delay_vs_estimate', 'share_reviewed',
    ]

    # Заказы, совершённые строго до seed_time
    orders_hist = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time].copy()
    # Позиции (объём продаж) — по ts позиции (момент покупки), строго до seed_time
    items_hist = items[items['ts'] < seed_time].copy()
    # Платежи — только те, что уже известны к seed_time
    payments_hist = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time].copy()
    # Отзывы — только уже опубликованные ответы
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews['review_answer_timestamp'] < seed_time].copy()

    if orders_hist.empty or items_hist.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=list(entity_ids), columns=feature_cols)

    base = items_hist.merge(
        orders_hist[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
                     'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']],
        on='order_id', how='inner'
    )
    if base.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=list(entity_ids), columns=feature_cols)

    base['revenue'] = base['price'] + base['freight_value']
    grp = base.groupby('product_id')

    features = pd.DataFrame(index=grp.size().index)
    features['order_count'] = grp['order_id'].nunique()
    features['item_count'] = grp.size()
    features['total_revenue'] = grp['revenue'].sum()
    features['avg_price'] = grp['price'].mean()
    features['median_price'] = grp['price'].median()
    features['std_price'] = grp['price'].std()
    features['unique_sellers'] = grp['seller_id'].nunique()
    features['avg_freight'] = grp['freight_value'].mean()

    last_purchase = grp['order_purchase_timestamp'].max()
    first_purchase = grp['order_purchase_timestamp'].min()
    features['days_since_last_purchase'] = (seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days
    features['product_age_days'] = (seed_time - first_purchase).dt.days

    # Продажи по окнам (по позициям, ts уже отфильтрован)
    g30 = items_hist[items_hist['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)] \
        .groupby('product_id').size()
    g90 = items_hist[items_hist['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)] \
        .groupby('product_id').size()
    prev90 = items_hist[
        (items_hist['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)) &
        (items_hist['ts'] < seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90))
    ].groupby('product_id').size()
    prev30 = items_hist[
        (items_hist['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)) &
        (items_hist['ts'] < seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30))
    ].groupby('product_id').size()

    features['sales_last_30d'] = g30
    features['sales_last_90d'] = g90
    features['sales_prev_90d'] = prev90
    features['trend_30_vs_prev30'] = g30 / (prev30 + 1.0)

    # Платежи: средняя рассрочка по известным платежам заказа
    order_pay = payments_hist.groupby('order_id')['payment_installments'].mean()
    opay = base[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
    opay['inst'] = opay['order_id'].map(order_pay)
    features['avg_installments'] = opay.dropna(subset=['inst']) \
        .groupby('product_id')['inst'].mean()

    # Отзывы: только уже существующие
    order_rev = reviews_hist.groupby('order_id')['review_score'].mean()
    orev = base[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
    orev['rev'] = orev['order_id'].map(order_rev)
    features['avg_review_score'] = orev.dropna(subset=['rev']) \
        .groupby('product_id')['rev'].mean()
    features['review_count'] = orev.dropna(subset=['rev']) \
        .groupby('product_id')['rev'].size()
    low = orev.dropna(subset=['rev'])
    low = low[low['rev'] <= 2].groupby('product_id').size()
    features['share_score_1_2'] = low / features['review_count']
    n_orders = grp['order_id'].nunique()
    features['share_reviewed'] = orev.dropna(subset=['rev']) \
        .groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique() / n_orders

    # Доставка: только для заказов, УЖЕ доставленных до seed_time
    delivered_mask = (
        base['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() &
        (base['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    )
    delivered = base[delivered_mask].copy()
    if not delivered.empty:
        dgrp = delivered.groupby('product_id')
        features['avg_delivery_days'] = dgrp.apply(
            lambda x: (x['order_delivered_customer_date'] - x['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days.mean()
        )
        features['avg_delivery_delay_vs_estimate'] = dgrp.apply(
            lambda x: (x['order_delivered_customer_date'] - x['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days.mean()
        )

    features = features[~features.index.duplicated(keep='first')]
    features = features.reindex(list(entity_ids))
    features = features.fillna(0.0).astype(float)
    return features
